reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds Hong Kong Traditional Chinese localization and applies region-specific UI wording while leaving user content and other locales unchanged.

summaries.zh: 為 DeepSeek Harness 網頁介面加入香港繁體中文語言選項及港式用詞。
summaries.en: Adds a Hong Kong Traditional Chinese locale and region-specific wording to the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Adds a Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong) UI locale
Converts Simplified Chinese interface text to Traditional Chinese
Applies Hong Kong-specific terminology in localized UI strings
Rewrites selected permission labels and opted-in DOM content
Exposes conversion and opt-in marking functions through a browser global API
